preconditions.description: The length of the serial number is between 1 and 10^5.
The number of changes and checks combined is between 1 and 10^5.
The range of the change or check is within the bounds of the serial number length.
The period d is within the range of the length of the substring.
The digit c is between 0 and 9.

postconditions.description: The output for each check must be either 'YES' or 'NO' indicating whether the watch passed the check.
